storage.blurb: Where uploaded files are stored. The active backend is chosen in config.yaml / .env. Retention is set per upload (1–30 days, or kept permanently) on the Documents page — there's no global retention setting.
storage.title: Object storage

parser.title: PDF parsing
parser.optionPymupdf: PyMuPDF — fast, one chunk per page
parser.gpuOlderThanAmpere: Your GPU ({{name}}, capability {{capability}}) is older than Ampere —
parser.doclingCpuWarn: docling runs on CPU and is very slow (minutes per document, and large PDFs can hit the ingestion time limit). PyMuPDF is recommended on this hardware.

embedding.blurb: The embedding model turns documents into vectors. Changing the provider, model, or output dimensions changes the vector size — existing collections must be re-indexed or search will break. Changing only an API key is safe.
embedding.title: Embedding model
embedding.modelHint: the exact model id on this server
embedding.maxRpmHint: throttle embeds so bulk ingestion stays under the provider's quota (each text = one request); blank or 0 = unlimited

reranker.blurb: The reranker reorders retrieved chunks by true query relevance before the final cut — the biggest precision win. It's optional and safe: if the model or a remote provider is unavailable, search falls back to its normal ranking.
reranker.title: Reranker
reranker.modelHintCrossEncoder: a HuggingFace cross-encoder id; the baked default is offline-safe
reranker.topNHint: max candidates the reranker scores per collection

search.blurb: Adjacency expansion pulls the chunks next to each result and merges them into one span, so a section that runs across pages comes back whole instead of cut at the top-K boundary. It's a plain lookup — no extra model calls — and safe: if it can't fetch, search returns the un-expanded results.
search.title: Retrieval
search.expandHint: chunks pulled on each side of a hit; 0 = off, max {{max}}

mcp.blurb: The MCP endpoint (/api/mcp) throttles each API key to this many requests per minute; the next request in the same minute returns 429. Each key gets its own budget, and the new limit applies to the next MCP request
mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.rateLimitHint: per API key on /api/mcp; the next request in the same minute returns 429
